about: Measured melts from SciGlass made only of the stage 01 bench's oxides, each with a MYEGA fit to its viscosity curve. mol lists mol% in the order of `oxides`; visc lists [log10 viscosity in Pa·s, temperature °C]; fit gives log10 η∞ (Pa·s), Tg (°C, where η = 10^12 Pa·s), fragility m and the rms misfit in decades, with log10 η∞ fixed at -2.93 (Zheng et al. 2011). src keys `sources`, each [short citation, full citation].
